_comment: Design 7.1.2: the paper ladder's station, a vat with a hollow centre. Phasmium walls hold it, as
phasmium frames the portal and the cage; the temperstone is the heating plate with blaze powder under
it, since pulping is cooking; the sticky piston is the beater driving down into the vat. Arc crystal
is not here because the pulper needs a block of it beside it, and a cauldron of water.
